skill.summary: Generate AI music with Suno via API or browser, with prompt engineering and song extensions.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Generate music with Suno via API or browser, with prompt engineering and project tracking.

- Supports AI music generation via hosted APIs (aimusicapi.ai, EvoLink) or browser automation at suno.com.
- Includes prompt engineering guides for style, lyrics, and song extensions.
- Tracks successful prompts, projects, and downloaded songs locally in ~/suno/.
- Provides comprehensive setup, quick reference, and troubleshooting documentation.
- Does not store API keys in plain text or access files outside its directory.
